text: At Vantry’s test strip on Tuesday afternoon, engineers said the maglev prototype reached a top recorded speed of 380 km/h during a series of supervised runs, according to project lead Mara Kells. I watched the white-and-teal car glide past the platform with a low, steady hum, then heard applause from the control tent when the number flashed on the timing screen. Kells told me the run was completed without incident and that brake checks afterward came back “within expected range.” She said the trial, conducted in clear weather, was the fastest yet for the vehicle and beat the team’s previous benchmark by 22 km/h. Technicians began post-run inspections before sunset.
